issue: SC GST missing from manual bill print (Dashboard + Order Taking) but present in Collect Bill print

collect_bill_path.line: L1954: gst_tax += serviceChargeAmount * scTaxRate (scTaxRate from overrides.serviceChargeTaxPct)

manual_print_path.gap: serviceChargeAmount is read (L1969) but never multiplied by scTaxRate and added to gst_tax

passes: gstTax from paymentData.printGstTax (sgst+cgst including SC GST)

fix.location: buildBillPrintPayload manual print path, after L2010
fix.change: Add: const scTaxRateManual = (overrides.serviceChargeTaxPct || 0) / 100; gst_tax = Math.round((gst_tax + serviceChargeAmount * scTaxRateManual) * 100) / 100;
